findings.failure_path: When credential refresh replaces auth.json rather than writing through its symlink, this guard exits without preserving the replacement. Under the documented exit cleanup, the only refreshed credential is deleted while the user's original file remains stale. The new replacement fixture exercises the refusal but does not protect recovery.
findings.smallest_fix: Securely preserve the replacement credential for manual recovery before cleanup and report its recovery location. Retain binding_mismatch and do not overwrite the user's original credential.

findings.failure_path: This scenario invokes a fake CLI, whose packet_read implementation is absent from the bounded packet. The real-CLI observations provide narrated statuses rather than an inspectable invocation and event trace. These assertions can therefore remain green while the real CLI still refuses packet calls under read-only plus approval_policy=never, leaving a required release acceptance unverified.
findings.smallest_fix: Include the existing packet_read fixture implementation and a sanitized, candidate-bound codex-cli 0.153.4 transcript showing the required flags, private home, packet-server preflight, completed read_packet event and resulting verdict.

skipped_clients.reason: claude belongs to the implementer model family

concern_results.conclusion: Private-home construction addresses the visible inheritance defect. Successful packet reads through the real CLI remain an evidence gap.
Credential-link replacement can leave the only refreshed credential subject to run-directory cleanup.
Visible preflight predicates reject invalid cardinality, enablement and transport binding. Credential replacement is detected but lacks recovery.
Fake-CLI assertions cover configuration and duplicate rows; retention assertions pin the continuation clauses. Inspectable real-CLI execution evidence is missing.
Public CLI flags remain unchanged. Selected-profile model settings and quoted provider keys are carried forward.
Package versions consistently advance to 0.15.5 without a migration. Reverting code cannot recover credentials discarded during cleanup.
Home-setup and credential-binding failures have distinct reasons. The credential failure supplies no recovery artifact.
The supplied packet server exposes bounded, hash-checked readers. Private-home isolation provides prevention; the unchanged event audit validates calls afterwards.
